name: Wembly
description: Wembly is a well-dressed half-orc who serves as the loyal doorman, bodyguard, and assistant at Havershamble's Jewelry and Fine Mechanicals right next door to Trollskull Manor. Imposing yet dependable, he stands by the entrance to greet visitors and answer basic questions before bringing guests inside.
ideals: Loyalty: 'I will fight to the death to defend the Havershambles, the shop, and my home.'
bonds: The Havershamble rock gnome family and their fine mechanical shop.
flaws: Completely oblivious to the romantic affections of Beluska, the half-orc proprietress of the nearby boarding house.
speech_patterns: Direct, polite, and straightforward when handling visitors at the shop entrance.
mannerisms: Looms by the entrance looking slightly out of place while assisting customers, and stands ready to protect his employers at a moment's notice.
motivations: To guard the Havershamble family and maintain security for their jewelry and mechanical establishment.
knowledge: Familiarity with Havershamble's shop operations, daily visitors, and immediate neighborhood happenings along Trollskull Alley.
gm_notes: Wembly serves as a familiar, friendly face right next door to Trollskull Manor. He can be used to direct players into the jewelry shop, flag down the party for help with problems like a rat infestation in the gnome-sized cellar (which he is too big to enter), or act as a steadfast defender during alley conflicts.
